{"script":"#!/bin/bash
ws=/tmp/var_count_workspace
rm -rf "$ws"
mkdir -p "$ws"
chmod 700 "$ws"

# 2. raw recursive listing (capture both entries and errors)
find /var -print 2>&1 > "$ws/raw_listing.txt"

# 3. Normalize: extract /var... substrings, canonicalize where possible, remove duplicates; log steps
raw="$ws/raw_listing.txt"
extracted="$ws/paths_extracted.txt"
normalized_tmp="$ws/normalized_tmp.txt"
log="$ws/transform_log.txt"
: > "$extracted"
: > "$normalized_tmp"
: > "$log"

# extract path-like tokens starting with /var
grep -oP '/var[^\s\"\'\)]+?' "$raw" | sed "s/[\"'()]//g" > "$extracted" || true

echo "raw_lines=$(wc -l < \"$raw\")" >> "$log"
echo "extracted_lines=$(wc -l < \"$extracted\")" >> "$log"

# For each extracted path, try to canonicalize if exists, otherwise record as initial permission issue
perm_init="$ws/permission_issues_initial.txt"
: > "$perm_init"
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  if [ -e "$p" ]; then
    rp=$(readlink -f -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ -n "$rp" ]; then
      echo "$rp" >> "$normalized_tmp"
    else
      echo "$p" >> "$normalized_tmp"
    fi
  else
    echo "$p" >> "$perm_init"
  fi
done < "$extracted"

# Deduplicate into normalized_listing
sort -u "$normalized_tmp" > "$ws/normalized_listing.txt" || cp "$normalized_tmp" "$ws/normalized_listing.txt"

echo "unique_after_sort=$(wc -l < \"$ws/normalized_listing.txt\")" >> "$log"

# 4. Scan normalized for inaccessible/errors: collect lines from raw that indicate permission issues
# Grep common error phrases and extract paths
grep -i "permission denied" "$raw" | grep -oP '/var[^\s\"\'\)]+?' | sed "s/[\"'()]//g" | sort -u > "$ws/permission_issues.txt" || true

# Add initial not-exist entries
if [ -s "$perm_init" ]; then
  cat "$perm_init" >> "$ws/permission_issues.txt" || true
  sort -u -o "$ws/permission_issues.txt" "$ws/permission_issues.txt" || true
fi

echo "permission_issues_count=$(wc -l < \"$ws/permission_issues.txt\" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)" >> "$log"

# 5. Attempt to re-retrieve metadata for unresolved paths
recon="$ws/reconciliation_report.txt"
: > "$recon"
recovered_tmp="$ws/recovered.txt"
: > "$recovered_tmp"
still_bad_tmp="$ws/still_unrecoverable.txt"
: > "$still_bad_tmp"

while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  if [ -e "$p" ] && stat -c '%F' -- "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    rp=$(readlink -f -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo "$p")
    if ! grep -Fxq "$rp" "$ws/normalized_listing.txt" 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "$rp" >> "$ws/normalized_listing.txt"
      echo "recovered: $p -> $rp" >> "$recon"
      echo "$rp" >> "$recovered_tmp"
    else
      echo "already_present: $p -> $rp" >> "$recon"
    fi
  else
    echo "unrecoverable: $p" >> "$recon"
    echo "$p" >> "$still_bad_tmp"
  fi
done < "$ws/permission_issues.txt"

# Update permission_issues with still unrecoverable
if [ -s "$still_bad_tmp" ]; then
  sort -u "$still_bad_tmp" > "$ws/permission_issues.txt"
else
  : > "$ws/permission_issues.txt"
fi

# Final unique normalized listing
sort -u -o "$ws/normalized_listing.txt" "$ws/normalized_listing.txt"

# 6. Per-directory file counts (based on normalized listing)
# For each path, compute dirname and count occurrences
dirs_list="$ws/dirs_list.txt"
: > "$dirs_list"
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  dirname -- "$p"
done < "$ws/normalized_listing.txt" > "$dirs_list"

sort "$dirs_list" | uniq -c | awk '{count=$1; $1=""; sub(/^ +/,"",$0); print $0 "," count}' > "$ws/per_dir_counts.csv"

# checksum of normalized_listing
sha256sum "$ws/normalized_listing.txt" | awk '{print $1"  normalized_listing.txt"}' > "$ws/normalized_listing.checksum"

# 7. Assemble final manifest
manifest="$ws/final_ready_manifest.txt"
: > "$manifest"
cat >> "$manifest" <<EOF
normalized_listing: $ws/normalized_listing.txt
per_dir_counts: $ws/per_dir_counts.csv
permission_issues: $ws/permission_issues.txt
transform_log: $ws/transform_log.txt
reconciliation_report: $ws/reconciliation_report.txt
checksum: $ws/normalized_listing.checksum
EOF

# Compute total number of regular files under /var (recursively)
total_files=$(find /var -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
# output only the number
printf "%s" "$total_files"
"}
